pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all rows are 0 and CHECK rejects 2.
'AC-2' test covers / and ?view=open, id order, done excluded.
'AC-3' test marks 3,1 and expects ✓ items in id order.
'AC-4' test expects all three in id order with ✓ on done only.
'AC-5' asserts exact nav HTML for each view and default.
'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty, __proto__.
'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet., and No items yet. in all three views.
traffic/routes.json lists both; 'AC-8' test asserts it.

findings.what: The final commit 'Follow-up edits' (9b4f612) deletes the state-table test 'All view: every item, All current' without any spec justification. The 'All view' state row (every item, no message, All current) now has no test of its own. AC-4 and AC-5 cover the list and the nav separately, and nothing checks that no message shows. The commit message hides the deletion.
findings.fix: Restore the deleted test, or cover the whole All-view row (all items, message null, All) in another test.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', but the final commit deleted a test. The earlier change to test/traffic.test.js was disclosed.
findings.fix: Correct the claim or restore the test.

findings.what: The AC-8 test only reads routes.json. It does not show the routes are exercised, though the traffic test's fake app was extended to record the query.
findings.fix: Optional: add a traffic test that a round requests the query routes.

lenses.note: The change follows the spec's decisions: it opens on open items and uses a query parameter.
All eight acceptance items are met, but the All-view state row lost its test.
One state test was deleted in the last commit.
No defects found. Object.hasOwn guards __proto__ and the view value is allow-listed.
Titles are escaped, the SQL fragments are constants, and the view value is allow-listed.
The diff touches no UI files beyond server-rendered HTML in src/index.js.
No browser flow or UI files were changed.
The 'tests deleted: none' claim is false.
